purpose: Condition only the source-derived atom coefficients of the actually observed signed response D=P-T(P). Preserve the current orthogonal response and use the independently frozen final source-DC innovation target. This is a narrow response-history combination, not a new source pilot or established stain/wave solution.

novelty_review.already_tested: Whole-image delta mean or integer-frequency delta mean with a sample-variance 3-sigma deadband; moving-light lag and the noiseless linear-ramp blind spot remained.
novelty_review.difference: Average only at most four real physical atom coefficients, transport them by source-only phase decisions, leave the instantaneous atom-orthogonal D unchanged, and do not use D sample variance as an innovation scale. The mean/ramp limitation remains if source changes are invisible to the source cuts.

novelty_review.already_tested: Current-inclusive complex affine D regression against integer-frequency P, optional age or global luminance DC, with source-noise ridge. Current-sample leverage can copy response impulses.
novelty_review.difference: No D-to-P regression, learned gain, age fit, ridge, or response innovation test. Coordinates are a fixed source-selected physical subspace, and history transport uses source phase only. Current D still contributes 1/n to its coefficient mean, so endogenous covariance is not removed.

novelty_review.already_tested: Normalized D/P history and current or historical P/T(P) gain applied to B, with near-zero fallback; homogeneous scaling works but moving detail can lag.
novelty_review.difference: No radiance or response division and no inverse response. Source illumination events cut history rather than rescale old D coefficients. Small true illumination drift can still lag.

novelty_review.already_tested: Source/guide beta histories, nominal covariance innovations and shrink, or conditioned source DC/nonDC. They modify P and require fresh T(P). Shared guide noise, slow drift, weak detail and startup failures remained.
novelty_review.difference: Keep both P and its matching measured T(P) exactly fixed. Filter coefficients of their actual signed difference without shrinking their amplitudes or treating source-fit covariance as native D covariance.

novelty_review.already_tested: Local response-feature least squares, conditioning/leverage/heldout gates and propagated uncertainty; missing full covariance and noisy framewise targets were independently diagnosed.
novelty_review.difference: No local response-feature design or response-derived confidence/heldout decision. Source-derived global physical coordinates and explicit model assumptions replace those gates; no statistical confidence claim is made.

scope_of_novelty: The substantive untested combination is low-dimensional continuous physical D coefficients plus source-only phase transport and source-only change cuts, while preserving current dense residual and frozen final DC. Temporal coefficient averaging itself is old. Renaming an FFT mean or a coefficient deadband would not be novel; this proposal adds neither a new noise-identification mechanism nor a guarantee.

application_only: matching native B for composition and exact invalid-radiance fallback
forbidden: old T(P) paired with changed P
causal_inputs.label: Observable-response conditioner: D necessarily receives the native T(P). Phase, illumination cuts and DC target are source-only, but the whole operator must not be labeled a raw-only source estimator.

fixed_constants.source_phase_rules: unchanged: at least8 past, debiased power>16, coherence>=0.8, nominal phase significance3SE, rank1 theta0
fixed_constants.source_innovation: unchanged frozen source atom innovation flag, nominal3RMS; no new D threshold
fixed_constants.DC_target: unchanged model.py SHA96a1becba58d02e3aa20178be6d205e9aa87d9c9dd283318d5dc118efd4a0ac0; history64,3 nominal SE, ROI margin5, min source mean1e-4

physical_basis: For each frozen source frequency (fx,fy), full-image centered coordinates are x=(pixelX-(W-1)/2)/W and y=(pixelY-(H-1)/2)/H. Physical columns are cos(2*pi*(fx*x+fy*y)) and sin(...), individually centered over the fixed interior ROI.

Use the source model's canonical atom ordering and rank/column identity. Jointly fit all retained physical columns to D_i minus its current interior RGB mean in float64. One geometric solve serves all three RGB right-hand sides. Do not rotate coefficients into a frame-varying SVD basis.

A rank2 atom uses z=(beta_cos-i*beta_sin)/2 per RGB, reconstructed as 2*Re(z)*cos-2*Im(z)*sin. A physically one-column self-conjugate/Nyquist atom uses its canonical real coefficient; theta is exactly0. It is not assigned a fictitious sine coefficient or zero frequency uncertainty.

Joint SVD is only a numerical rank/condition check of the canonical physical design. Across-atom rank loss, mixed column dependence, unrecorded column identity or condition>10000 makes coefficient filtering unsupported: use current D and the frozen DC application, clear atom history, and disclose the fallback. No adaptive atom dropping based on D or scores.

Let A_i be full-image reconstruction of the jointly fitted current coefficients and O_i=D_i-A_i. Keep O_i exactly current. In particular current signed D DC and all dense/out-of-subspace corrections remain in O_i; the basis has zero interior mean. No nonnegative residual carrier or spectral refilter is introduced.
phase_transport: For each rank2 atom, theta_i is exactly the frozen source diagnostic's phase_increment, computed from preceding source coefficients only. phase_used=false gives theta_i=0. No phase estimate from D, T(P), B or truth is permitted.

Within an unchanged source/basis/qualification epoch, maintain psi_i=psi_(i-1)+theta_i. The first frame after a cut uses psi_i=0. Store each unfiltered actual coefficient z_j and its psi_j. Transport past coefficients to current coordinates by z_j*exp(i*(psi_i-psi_j)), include current z_i, and take their unweighted mean over at most16 actual observations.

This integrates causal source phase increments instead of rephasing every old coefficient with the current slope. It is a model assumption that the response atom follows that source phase. Its validity is not implied by high source coherence. No amplitude normalization is used.

Rank1 coefficients use ordinary real inclusive means. Every atom shares the same history-cut interval and current-inclusive observation count, but has its own phase path. Reconstruct the mean physical coefficients jointly; no independent orthogonal-atom projection or shrink.

A changed source phase_used qualification clears all atom histories before storing current D, avoiding transport across a newly changed phase model. A smoothly changing theta remains integrated; acceleration/model bias remains a scored counterexample.
exact_order_and_state: Validate all shapes, matching source/native identities and causal source diagnostics. Diagnostic epochs must be integer, nondecreasing and no later than the current frame. Optional exposure absent is unknown, not constant exposure proof. Malformed array shape raises.

Update the independent frozen source-DC target on every source frame, including the pilot's first8 inactive warmup. Its source_epoch and DC_epoch remain distinct. No D or B value influences that estimator.

Before any D-history read, cut atom history on reset, exact jitter change, source epoch change, supplied exposure change, any frozen source atom innovation, DC-target innovation, changed frequency/order/rank/column identity, changed phase_used qualification, previous unsupported/inactive frame, or invalid current metadata/source/P/T(P). Source-side events cut all atom histories together.

Existing inactive pilot frames return exact B and do not feed D coefficient history. Thus first8 inactive frames remain exact native baseline; no old-basis warmup residual or D is imported into a new atom epoch.

Active no-atom or unsupported-projection frames use current C=B+D followed by the already frozen source-DC target application and atomic radiance fallback, then clear atom history. This equals the new DC control, not an invented zero correction. An invalid DC target returns exact B and clears atom history.

For valid active source atoms and finite signed D, jointly project current D, establish current phase path after any cut, append its unfiltered actual coefficients, then compute the inclusive transported mean. The first new-epoch coefficient has n=1 and reproduces current D algebraically; n grows to16. No extra eight-frame activation switch, no averaging of previously filtered coefficients.

Compose C_new=B+O_current+A_history, apply the frozen source-only DC target once over the full image, then atomic wholeRGB invalid pixel->exact B. Do not clamp or reapply DC after fallback. Baseline invalid raises. Nonfinite projection/history/reconstruction returns exact B for the whole frame and cuts history; signed D is legal and is never clipped.

Record the full signed pre-DC/pre-fallback output, candidate invalid pixels, atomic fallback masks and target closure before/after fallback. Report unsupported coefficient filtering separately from baseline inactivity and valid no-atom current-D behavior.

bounded_cost: At most4 physical columns, cached basis/factorization per source model epoch. Per valid frame, O(M*4*3) projection plus O(16*4*3) history transport and O(HW*4*3) reconstruction. No frequency optimization, new source FFT, giant covariance matrix, parameter search or native dispatch. Source diagnostics/DC target may be regenerated by their unchanged authenticated modules; this is separate from coefficient filter cost.

evaluation_after_review_only.coverage: No matching harmonic native P/TP exists for other7 source families or22 source adversaries. Single known constructed operators below test algebra/mechanism only and cannot fill this native quality gap.
selfchecks_and_known_operator_controls: Exact future-prefix invariance of target, frequency identity, cut decisions, history indices, phase paths and output; resets/jitter/exposure/source epoch must remove stale coefficients.

Static off-grid atom plus coefficient noise in an explicitly known operator: coefficient fluctuation reduction and exact current dense residual preservation. Noise independence is constructor-known only.
Constant-speed source phase with a response atom that shares its phase, and a phase-locked response with changing RGB amplitude; source-only transport behavior and per-frame absolute gain/phase.
Counterexample: static-source atom but a genuinely changing native correction coefficient. No source cut observes it; mean lags and attenuates correction, even if D sample statistics look like noise.

Counterexample: moving source atom but guide-fixed/static response artifact at the same frequency; source phase transport can rotate an artifact incorrectly. High source coherence does not establish the response phase law.
Slow amplitude ramp, chromatic light step, subthreshold illumination drift, acceleration, disocclusion and phase qualification toggle; retained lag and startup errors rather than tuned thresholds.
Rank1 Nyquist real coefficient and joint close-atom dependence: deterministic canonical rank, no imaginary phase, unsupported-rank exact control behavior.

Correlated RGB/time/shared D bias and endogenous B/D cancellation: averaging can remove useful covariance or preserve bias. Report actual covariance and output error; never label D coefficient variance pure noise.
Signed D, near-zero source, absent exposure, nonfinite metadata, invalid P/TP/B, overflow reconstruction and samepixel wholeRGB fallback; source/P bits unchanged.

No-atom dense correction and instantaneous orthogonal response changes: candidate must reproduce the frozen DC-only control exactly before arithmetic rounding/fallback. Full-image extrapolated atom plus residual must preserve D decomposition.

information_limits_and_stop_rules: True correction changes and native stochastic/history variation can yield the same observable D trajectory with unchanged source. No source-only cut can distinguish them; this is the central unidentifiability, not a missing SE formula.

D=P-T(P) is endogenous to noisy P and temporally/state-correlated native response. Source coefficient SE, nominal IID phase uncertainty, residual spatial variance or sample variance cannot serve as calibrated D uncertainty. No pseudo-SE or coefficient confidence is introduced.

Source frequency selection/holdout and phase diagnostics remain adaptive with unknown RGB/time covariance; full-source sigma includes validation pixels and second-atom acceptance reuses them. Physical rank-aware coordinates do not cure those limits.

Weak baseline mature nonDC variance4.880723e-9 already dominates D_atom1.571463e-9; retaining baseline and current orthogonal D leaves a substantial floor. Projection alone cannot remove dominant weak atom fluctuation, and averaging cannot restore a source atom never selected or its lost phase.

Current orthogonal D deliberately preserves dense detail and also preserves orthogonal correction noise. Learned-frequency common error and projection/residual anticovariance must remain explicit. A lower atom variance alone is not a final-output improvement.

All6 prior harmonic full absolute-detail gates failed, including first8 exact B; source weak/startup/dense phase failures remain. A mature improvement cannot become a full-sequence or game solution claim.

If the proposed source phase law is falsified or output strict-noise/detail gates fail, keep the failure. Do not switch to D-derived phase, coefficient shrink/deadband, scene-based alpha, different history or a threshold sweep in this package.
